content.content: `deccy show zzzzzzzz` prints a marker for the root; the root names no file, so no document is written.
content.rationale: The root is the one id that resolves to no document (D3/S2-root), so O8's document rendering has no case for it; naming a marker keeps `deccy show` a total surface over resolution — every valid target prints something — without re-deciding resolution or O8's document form.
